messages:
Amelia (Sales): VaultLane POC kickoff. Need compact scope and pass gates to present to procurement. Want eval harness + golden prompts.
Tom (SE): List flows: chat-help, invoice extraction, policy-check, doc-summarize, embeddings retrieval. Recommend 100 goldens.
Leah (Solutions): Need traffic: peak RPS and avg token lengths. Also ask about masked PII.
Amelia (Sales): Client: peak chat 90 RPS (avg 140 tokens), extraction 22 RPS (avg 360 tokens). They aim for chat p95 <240ms.
Tom (SE): Proposed scoring: 0-3 scale, pass if mean>=2.5 and per-flow>=84%. Regression gate: weekly mean drop >6% or any golden >10% drop.
Priya (Security): Security asks: SSO/SCIM, KMS, audit logs, retention policy. Legal needs DPA and confirmation of no payload retention for hosted trial.
Leah (Solutions): We'll run ephemeral mode (KV off, TTL=0) for trial. I'll prepare harness + runner.
Amelia (Sales): Goldenset split: chat 36, extraction 28, summarize 14, policy 12, embeddings 10 = 100. Can we compress to 10 business days if data arrives day 0?
Tom (SE): Yes if labeled goldenset + endpoint CSV arrive day 0. Manual QA 8 examples/flow.
Leah (Solutions): Pricing B.O.E. after CSV. Please provide CSV endpoint,RPS,avg_tokens.
Amelia (Sales): Action items: Amelia get CSV + DPA confirm; Leah scaffold harness; Tom upload prompts + scoring; Priya send minimal security checklist. Sync tomorrow 11am PT.
deploy-bot: Runner queued: vaultlane-poc-harness-1733333333. Started: 1733333600
Amelia (Sales): Thanks, see you tomorrow.
